verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say you can export and sync a project to GitHub (or GitLab) and "deploy outside Lovable." You can also download the codebase directly from Project settings, so the generated app's code can be taken to another host. missing for 10: step-by-step guides for deploying to specific external hosts or self-managed infrastructure, documentation on running the built-in Cloud backend (database/auth/functions) outside Lovable, independent or hands-on confirmation of an external deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure

citations.quote: you can export and sync your project to GitHub: back up your code, review changes in pull requests, work locally in your IDE, test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable
If you only need a copy of your code, you can download your code directly from Lovable: use the Download codebase section in Project settings → Git
Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab, and keeps the two in sync automatically
